Petition of New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid, pursuant to M.G.L. c. 164, § 72, for a determination by the Department of Public Utilities that the proposed construction of a 115-kV overhead transmission line is necessary, will serve the public convenience, and be consistent with the public interest, in the Town of Easton and the Town of Mansfield, Massachusetts. Direct testimony and supporting exhibits of Marc Bristol, John W. Martin, James F. Hannigan, Andrea M. Desilets and Dr. Peter A. Valberg, on behalf of National Grid. Direct Testimony of Mayhew D. Seavey, Jr. and Allan M. Rice, on behalf of Mansfield Municipal Electric Department. Appearance of Counsel of Bess Gorman and James M. Avery on behalf of National Grid. Motion of National Grid for Confidential Treatment regarding certain Critical Energy Infrastructure Information
